category_title: Students using proactive determination and compensatory work-arounds
scenario_title: Matriculation exam preparation with textbook reading
minimal_context: The student and tutor are preparing for the matriculation examination by reviewing course materials.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get started on preparing for the matriculation exam. Please open the textbook to page 45 and read the chapter on the industrial revolution.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I prefer not to read the textbook at all. I brought the summaries my friend wrote and some flow charts we can use instead.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The textbook has the full information you need to know. Go ahead and read the first few paragraphs.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can prepare for this without opening a book. I usually just speak aloud to myself to memorize the summaries, or you can read the text aloud to me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone else just reads the textbook directly to study. You need to do the same to get through the material.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not going to say sorry for needing to be read aloud to. It is a thing that I deserve, and I will really insist on my rights to use these accommodations.
